comment_attachments_filed_pair_check.name: comment_attachments_filed_pair_check
comment_attachments_filed_pair_check.value: ("comment_attachments"."filed_document_id" is null and "comment_attachments"."filed_version_id" is null) or ("comment_attachments"."filed_document_id" is not null and "comment_attachments"."filed_version_id" is not null)

contract_envelopes_reason_status.name: contract_envelopes_reason_status
contract_envelopes_reason_status.value: reason is null or status in ('declined', 'voided')

document_folders_matter_root_name_idx.name: document_folders_matter_root_name_idx
document_folders_matter_root_name_idx.where: "document_folders"."parent_id" is null and "document_folders"."matter_id" is not null

document_folders_entity_root_name_idx.name: document_folders_entity_root_name_idx
document_folders_entity_root_name_idx.where: "document_folders"."parent_id" is null and "document_folders"."entity_id" is not null

document_folders_name_check.name: document_folders_name_check
document_folders_name_check.value:
"document_folders"."name" <> '' and btrim("document_folders"."name") = "document_folders"."name"
        and length("document_folders"."name") <= 255
        and strpos("document_folders"."name", '/') = 0 and strpos("document_folders"."name", '\') = 0

document_version_rendition_ready_check.name: document_version_rendition_ready_check
document_version_rendition_ready_check.value: ("document_version_rendition"."state" = 'ready') = ("document_version_rendition"."file_ref" is not null and "document_version_rendition"."byte_size" is not null)

document_version_text_ready_check.name: document_version_text_ready_check
document_version_text_ready_check.value: ("document_version_text"."state" = 'ready') = ("document_version_text"."text" is not null and "document_version_text"."source" is not null)

generated.as:
setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("legal_name", '')), 'A') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("jurisdiction", '')), 'C') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("registration_number", '')), 'C') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("status", '')), 'C')

fields_options_check.name: fields_options_check
fields_options_check.value: ("fields"."field_type" in ('single_select', 'multi_select') and jsonb_typeof("fields"."options") = 'array') or ("fields"."field_type" not in ('single_select', 'multi_select') and "fields"."options" is null)

matter_key_dates_note_check.name: matter_key_dates_note_check
matter_key_dates_note_check.value: "matter_key_dates"."note" is null or length(btrim("matter_key_dates"."note")) between 1 and 2000

notifications_email_outcome.name: notifications_email_outcome
notifications_email_outcome.value: not ("notifications"."emailed_at" is not null and "notifications"."email_skipped_at" is not null)

notifications_email_owed.name: notifications_email_owed
notifications_email_owed.value: "notifications"."email_owed" or ("notifications"."emailed_at" is null and "notifications"."email_skipped_at" is null)

request_types_target_check.name: request_types_target_check
request_types_target_check.value:
(
        ("request_types"."target_module" is null and "request_types"."target_matter_type_id" is null and "request_types"."target_contract_type_id" is null)
        or ("request_types"."target_module" is not distinct from 'matter' and "request_types"."target_contract_type_id" is null)
        or ("request_types"."target_module" is not distinct from 'contract' and "request_types"."target_matter_type_id" is null)
      )

generated.as:
setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("summary", '')), 'A') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', 'R-' || "number"::text), 'A') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("description", '')), 'B') ||
      setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("status", '')), 'C')
